about.label: About
about.title: Where engineering meets user experience.
about.p1: I'm a Frontend Developer focused on building modern, scalable, and user-centered web applications. My primary hands-on experience is with React, Next.js, and Angular. I've also worked with Vue/Nuxt on real-world projects, gaining practical experience with its ecosystem and building user interfaces with these technologies.
about.p2: I enjoy solving complex frontend challenges, collaborating with development teams, and turning ideas into reliable digital products. My experience includes enterprise applications, data-driven interfaces, and geospatial platforms, which has helped me develop a deeper understanding of frontend engineering. Continuous learning and expanding my technical knowledge are important parts of my professional journey. I'm curious about new technologies, enjoy exploring different tools and approaches, and am comfortable adapting to different technology stacks based on a project's requirements.

items.desc: Working independently on frontend development projects, focusing on responsive user interfaces, practical product features, and improved user experiences. I aim to deliver structured, maintainable code and choose technical solutions that align with each product's requirements. I'm also open to joining professional teams and contributing to the development of web products.

Contributed to the frontend development of enterprise and GIS-based applications using Angular and Next.js. Worked with complex data-driven interfaces, reusable components, dynamic form generation, and geospatial technologies. This experience strengthened my understanding of frontend architecture and the development of enterprise-scale software products.

Contributed to the implementation and development of user interfaces for websites and web applications. This role provided practical experience in a professional software development environment, working with React and Next.js, and translating designs and requirements into functional user interfaces.

items.desc: A nationwide platform for discovering and sharing tours and events. Contributed to its frontend development, focusing on dynamic content presentation, page structure, and seamless user interactions.

items.name: GeoNet
items.desc: A national platform for geospatial services and content, designed to provide integrated infrastructure for exchanging, sharing, and utilizing geographic data and services. Contributed to frontend development, implementing user interfaces, and upgrading the application across multiple major Angular versions.

items.name: GeoTajak Amayesh
items.tech: Next.js / React / TypeScript / OpenLayers / Axios / Proj4 / Recharts
items.desc: An intelligent land management platform designed to manage and organize land-related information, with integrated analytical capabilities. I led the project from its initial foundation to completion, taking responsibility for its overall direction and core frontend architecture. Built the application's foundation using Next.js and personally implemented a major portion of the platform, while coordinating and collaborating with three other team members. The project integrates geospatial visualization and data-driven capabilities using technologies such as OpenLayers.

items.name: GeoTajak
items.desc: An enterprise WebGIS platform for managing, editing, and integrating geospatial data. Contributed to frontend development, including geospatial layer management, dynamic form generation, and data-driven interfaces using Angular and GIS technologies.

items.desc: A fleet management platform for monitoring and controlling vehicles and equipment, built on the Traccar platform. Contributed to frontend development, implementing management and data-driven interfaces, and upgrading the application across multiple major Angular versions.

items.name: Montazer Ghaem Technical School
items.desc: My first website project, developed for Montazer Ghaem Technical School. The website introduces educational programs, school facilities, faculty members, and student achievements, while providing a platform for school news, announcements, and meeting requests.
